body: Mas malinaw na ngayon na hindi lang imported oil/rates shock ang pressure. Reuters reports Nikkei around -2.6%, habang parehong Ueda at Takata nagbigay ng hawkish BOJ signals today. That strengthens the domestic discount-rate leg of the morning thesis. Pero huwag i-overread ang isang bad session: the close still has to tell us whether this is broad regime deterioration or a sharp repricing concentrated in duration-sensitive names. Full scorecard belongs after reliable close/breadth data.

sources.title: Asian markets tumble as US-Iran fighting lifts oil and bond yields
BOJ must conduct rate hikes nimbly, hawkish board member says
BOJ chief vows to keep raising rates, debate price risks this month

claims.text: Reuters reported the Nikkei down about 2.6% during Asian trading on September 2.
BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda and board member Hajime Takata both delivered hawkish policy signals on September 2, emphasizing upside inflation risks and the case for continued or nimble rate increases.
claims.basis: Reuters reporting on separate September 2 BOJ remarks.

claims.text: The new BOJ remarks strengthen the domestic discount-rate channel in addition to the imported oil and global-yield shock identified in the pre-market article.
claims.basis: Cross-asset inference from simultaneous equity weakness and more hawkish domestic policy communication.
